maddeler.e:
نرتطم (form VIII)
# نَرْتَطِمُ (nartaṭimu) /nar.ta.tˤi.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَطَمَ (irtaṭama)
# نَرْتَطِمَ (nartaṭima) /nar.ta.tˤi.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَطَمَ (irtaṭama)
# نَرْتَطِمْ (nartaṭim) /nar.ta.tˤim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْتَطَمَ (irtaṭama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
